name: GB Road and Ajmeri Gate
notes: Described only as the hardware and parts street, the old gate and the station forecourt (DELHI_WORLD.md 3 and GAME.md respect rule); nothing about the trade above is shown or modelled here. The gate stands in a fenced traffic island (sheet 'Map notes').

buildings.balconies: green-painted timber balconies and jharokhas on shuttered upper floors, sunshades on the curved corners

gate_and_window_grilles.kind: rolled shutters in grey and blue on every ground floor; iron railing round the gate island

footpath.surface: broken concrete at the shops with steps, stools and stacked stock; a kerbed asphalt apron 8 to 10 m wide at the station forecourt with painted bays
footpath.kerb: yellow and black painted kerb at the station forecourt

lamps.kind: curved-arm poles at the gate, a high mast with a cluster of heads over the forecourt, shorter curved-arm poles along the station front, shop tubes and bulbs

kinds: iron railing round the gate island
yellow police barricades with white stripes at the junction mouths
rolled shutters on every ground floor
a low kerbed edge at the forecourt, not a wall

signs.boards: hand-painted trade boards (metals, hardware, pipes) in Hindi and English

life.people: porters and handcart drivers loading goods, shopkeepers at their thresholds, tea sellers, auto and cab drivers waiting for fares, families and travellers heading for the station

wear_notes: the station forecourt is cleaner, about 0.4

road.condition: patched grey asphalt with parked autos and tempos on both edges and few readable markings; two lanes each way plus parking at the gate
